title: Crystal Clear Bar Salts Summer Dream Nic Salts 10ml E-Liquid
description: Crystal Clear Summer Dream Nic Salt is a juicy tropical fruit medley combining Pineapple, Watermelon, Mango, Orange and Passion Fruit. The result is a bright, sun-soaked vape with layers of sweet and tangy flavour across every puff. Blended at 50VG/50PG, this Nic Salt e-liquid is ideal for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping using pod kits and vape pens. Available in 10mg and 20mg strengths for a smooth throat hit and fast-acting nicotine relief. Crystal Clear Nic Salts are crafted to deliver the same great-tasting flavours that made disposable vapes so popular, now reimagined for refillable pod kits. Designed for clarity, consistency and convenience, this UK-made range focuses on fruity, icy, and confectionery-inspired blends that cater to everyday vapers.
